specs.style: Polished cartoon, super-deformed chibi (≈2–2.5 heads tall), bold dark outlines, saturated cel shading; Metal-Slug-inspired military cartoon. Smooth anti-aliased edges, true transparent RGBA, no chroma halo.
specs.view: 3/4 top-down (oblique) to match BRIEF 斜俯视角双摇杆. All sprites face RIGHT; mirror with flipX for left. Free 360° aim: flip body by aim side, rotate bullets / muzzle flash to the aim angle.
specs.character_frame: 320x320, anchor (160,300) = feet contact point (bottom-centre). Heights: hero ≈200px, charger ≈190, rifleman ≈200, sniper ≈200, heavy ≈230, 老枪 ≈200, 零件 ≈165, 军火商人 ≈200. Death animations use a WIDER 512x320 frame with anchor (256,300), so the fall fits; the origin is still the feet. Suggested in-game display scale 0.35–0.5 (e.g. 0.4 → hero ≈80px on a 1280x720 / 1920x1080 view).
specs.feet_alignment: Every character animation (idle/run/shoot/attack/hurt/death…) is aligned by the FEET, not the body centre. Feet x = midpoint of the lowest silhouette band (bottom 10%). Non-death frames have their feet x on the anchor x (±2px). Death animations are shifted rigidly so that frame 00 has its feet on the anchor and the body then falls naturally. The boss tread centre is at x=320 (±1px). Swapping animations therefore causes no sideways jump; see alignment.json for per-frame numbers.
specs.frame_counts: Smoothed motion: run/move cycles are 8 distinct frames, attacks 6 (anticipation → hit → follow-through), hurt 3, death 6–8. Hero: idle 4, run 8, shoot 6, shoot_mg 4, reload 4, dash 6, throw 6, hurt 3, death 8. Each enemy: move 8, attack 6, hurt 3, death 6. Boss: move 8, cannon 6, mg 6, deploy 6, barrage 6, damaged 4, destroy 8, hurt_flash 2. The fps in each row is the suggested playback rate.
specs.npc: 老枪 (laoqiang, one-eyed veteran quartermaster: sortie + weapons) and 零件 (lingjian, echo-pod repair robot: respawn + armor +10 upgrade). Each has idle 4f at 320x320, anchor (160,300), plus a 512x512 transparent bust portrait for dialogue (npc/<who>/<who>_portrait.png). The hostage stays in npc/hostage. 军火商人 (merchant): original chubby shady black-market arms dealer (purple trench coat lined with weapons, fedora, tiny sunglasses, gold tooth) for the 军火商 room. He has idle 4f at 320x320, anchor (160,300), a 512x512 portrait, and merchant_stall: a trimmed 238x304 3/4 top-down weapons stall with its anchor at the bottom-centre ground contact (119,302). All are in npc/merchant/.
specs.scene: scenes/base_tinshack_bg.png is 1920x1080, opaque, 3/4 top-down 铁皮屋 hub. It has the echo pod, upgrade bench, weapon counter and sortie door painted in. Approximate interaction hotspots are in manifest.json → hotspots. The 4 base_* props are optional standalone cut-outs (320x320, anchor (160,312)) for highlights or layering.
specs.boss_frame: 640x512, anchor (320,490) = tread contact centre. Tank tread band normalised to 316px wide in every frame.
specs.tiles: Ground: seamless 256x256 (and 128x128 box-downscaled) opaque; world grid suggestion 128px at 1x (or 64px when sprites are drawn at 0.5). Concrete has 3 variants (concrete, concrete_b, concrete_c) with identical slab joints and edge slabs. Pick one at random per cell (e.g. 60/20/20) to break up repetition; the preview shows a mixed 7x4 test.
specs.props: Individual trimmed PNGs, anchor bottom-centre (sandbags ≈200 wide, crates ≈112–128, barrel 256x256 frame with barrel ≈96 tall, anchor (128,236)).
specs.fx: Explosion 256x256 centre anchor; muzzle flash 128x96 anchor (4,48) at the muzzle, points right; impact spark 96x96 centre.
specs.ui: Icons 128x128, subject fit in 112, centre anchor; scale to 32–64 for HUD.
specs.naming: <entity>_<anim>_<NN>.png frames + <entity>_<anim>_sheet.png horizontal strip (frame_count x 1, same frame size). Single sprites have no index.
specs.walls_doors: walls/: `wall` (game key) = 256x256 opaque top-of-wall texture (dark concrete blocks + steel rivet plates), seamless on BOTH axes so one texture fills the horizontal and vertical 28-px wall strips as a tileSprite; 256 px = DK.ART.wall 64 logical px (4x), `wall_128` is the 2x box-downscale. `door` (game key) = 112x440 opaque closed steel blast gate for the right-wall exit, exactly 4x the 28x110 logical gap (DK.WALL x gap), painted over the wall texture so its edges blend into the wall strips; centre anchor (56,220); the code hides it when the door opens.
specs.campfire: props/campfire_NN.png: 8-frame seamless loop, 256x256, anchor (128,244) bottom-centre (stone-ring ground contact), 10 fps. Frames are sampled every 9th frame of a Grok video whose first and last frame were pinned to the same still, so 07 -> 00 wraps without a jump; stones/logs/pot are pixel-static, only flames and embers move.
specs.portraits: Dialogue busts are 512x512 transparent, anchor (256,512), bottom edge = bust cut, face right: laoqiang/lingjian/merchant + mark_portrait (马克中士), hostage_portrait (人质), anvil_portrait (铁砧 turret close-up for 【广播】 lines). The game picks them up via DK.PORTRAIT_ART (<speaker>_portrait). Speaker 'system' intentionally has no portrait.
specs.shield: `shield` (game key): enemies/heavy/heavy_shield.png, trimmed 95x160 standalone riot shield matching the one painted into heavy_*, upright with its face toward +x; centre anchor; rotate to the heavy's facing. Only shown by the game while the heavy has no real sprite.
specs.pipeline: Grok Imagine (sprite-gen gen --provider grok) on #00FF00 key with one reference image per character for every animation sheet → sprite-gen slice-sheet (chroma alpha + shared baseline) / sprite-gen cutout → art_src/finalize.py (feet-anchor alignment, haze/speck cleanup, despill, edge fade) → verify.py. Smoothed animations (8-frame cycles, 6-frame attacks, etc.) come from sprite-gen Pipeline B: sprite-gen video-set with each character's same reference image (Grok video on a green key) → video frames → keyed frames → art_src/video_to_cuts.py, which picks loop frames by period fit and one-shot frames by arc-length (with manual picks in video_pick_overrides.json) and scales to the character height. idle, shoot_mg, reload, NPC idles and hostage are still from image sheets.
